question.text: Set <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi></math> has <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>m</mi></math>elements and set <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>B</mi></math> has <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>n</mi></math>elements. If the total number of subsets of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>112</mn></math> more than the total number of subsets of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>B</mi></math>, then the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>m</mi><mo>·</mo><mi>n</mi></math> is___.
